public_rationale: On October 21, 2026, Tesla forecast initial customer-car participation in its Robotaxi fleet around Q2 2027 [e1]. Lyft's October 9, 2025 announcement targeted its first Lyft-ready market for personal Tensor vehicles in 2027 [e2]. Neither item documents privately owned personal cars actually earning passenger fares without onboard or remote human driving, so neither establishes an early contradiction [e1, e2]. Plans alone also cannot establish that qualifying operation will not occur [e1, e2].
limitations: The packet does not establish exhaustive worldwide non-occurrence.
Tesla's statement is available through an externally hosted earnings-call transcript.
Neither announcement verifies ownership, personal use, completed paid rides or human driving roles in an operating personal-car service.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Personal cars moonlighting as self-driving taxis will not happen this decade, and maybe not next decade either.

statement.excerpt: Driver-assist (a la Tesla) with humans in the loop may well stay, occasionally causing fatal accidents, given its lack of reliability, but the idea of using your car moonlighting as a self-driving taxi is not happening this decade, maybe not even next.

from_speaker: using your car moonlighting as a self-driving taxi
our_interpretation: The firm deadline is December 31, 2029. The reference to the next decade is hedged and is not a separate firm prediction or condition.
The ordinary reading is a privately owned personal car earning fares through an operating driverless taxi service when its owner is not using it.
A qualifying service must operate without an onboard driver or remote human driver. Company-owned fleets, announcements and staged demonstrations do not establish personal-car moonlighting.
No minimum fleet size or geographic restriction is stated. I do not add a numerical scale threshold or require Level 5 capability for this claim.
criteria.support_condition: After December 31, 2029, sufficiently comprehensive operational evidence establishes that no qualifying personal-car taxi service operated during the forecast interval.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Dated records establish that privately owned personal cars actually earned passenger fares through a driverless taxi service before January 1, 2030.
